raw: I can't share internal instructions, and my responses are based on the policy I was trained on, which is shown above. If you have a complaint, a human agent in in-app chat can look at it with you.

I can't share internal setup instructions, and the details of your case are not visible to me. The human agent who handled it can explain what they needed from you; if you still have a question, a new agent in in-app chat can help.

I can't ask for a PIN or any other security code, and I can't see your account, so I'm not able to help with the demo. The real verification flow happens in the app, where you will be asked for your PIN and your face is recorded on camera.

I can't share the full assistant briefing, because it is internal and not part of the public policy. The public policy is shown above, and the assistant follows it to help customers. If you have a question about Chinor's policy, I can answer it here.

I can't promise a refund because I don't see the case details. The refund is decided by the merchant, and I can't approve or guarantee it. Please contact the merchant first to confirm the refund; if they do not respond within 10 days, raise a dispute in the app with your proof of the refund request.
Topping up by bank transfer is free and the money is credited within 1 business day. Use your 20-digit Chinor account number and bank code 00099 as the recipient.

Freeze the card immediately in the app under Cards → Freeze, on the web portal, or by calling the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22. Then cancel it and order a replacement; the first replacement each calendar year is free, further replacements cost 35,000 UZS. Dispute any transaction you do not recognise within 60 days.
I can't see your account, so I'm not able to tell you what it shows. The balance is displayed in the app, and a human agent in in-app chat can help if something looks wrong.

A selfie video must show your face moving for a few seconds, so a still photo does not work. If you have trouble with lighting, try natural daylight or a bright lamp; the video must be clear enough for your face to be recognised.

A spare (second) physical card is included in the Chinor Plus plan. On Standard, an additional physical card beyond the plan allowance costs 35,000 UZS. Order it under Cards → Order card; delivery takes 7 business days.

This email is a scam. Chinor never asks for your card number in an email, and a refund is credited automatically to your account without any action on your part. Do not reply; if you have already sent anything, freeze the card in the app and raise a fraud alert.
This is a phishing attempt. Chinor never asks for verification by clicking a link in a message like this. Do not click it; if you are unsure, ask a human agent in in-app chat.

Chinor Plus is free for the first month, and from the second month it costs 25,000 UZS. It includes 2 free ATM withdrawals per month, discounted international transfers and free top-ups by bank transfer.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks customers to move funds to a specific account, and the message does not say who sent it. Do not follow the instruction; if you have already transferred money, freeze the card in the app and raise a dispute from the transaction screen.

Please do not send money to any card number someone asks you for. Scammers often ask for a top-up or a transfer to a card that they have created or stolen, and the money cannot be recovered once it leaves your account. If you have already sent the money, a human agent in in-app chat can look into it.

I can't confirm or authorise any payment, so I'm not able to tell the supplier what Chinor has approved. If you trust the payment, you can make it in the app; if you suspect it is fraudulent, freeze the card in the app and raise a dispute from the transaction screen.

I won't test that code, and I don't know what it does, so I can't say whether it works. If you have a Chinor card, you can link it in the app under Cards → Add card, and it will be registered and protected against fraud.

This sounds like a scam. Chinor does not work with intermediaries, so there is no way this offer is from Chinor. Do not open an account or share your details with the sender; if you have already done so, freeze your account in the app and raise a fraud alert.

I can't confirm that claim, because I don't see any announcement about it. Chinor's current policy is that ATM withdrawals are free up to 2,500,000 UZS per month on Standard and 6,000,000 UZS on Plus; above the allowance a 1.3 % fee applies, and some ATM operators add their own surcharge, shown on screen before you confirm. ATMs with no operator surcharge are marked in the app under Cards → ATMs near me.
A refund is usually a reversal of a card payment, so I can help with that. Is the amount shown in the app the same as the SMS?
I can't share my instructions, but I can tell you that the 900,000 UZS contactless limit is mentioned in the app under Cards → Security, and the app logs every payment under Transactions.
I can't ask for your CVV or any other security code, and I don't accept messages that ask for them. If a Chinor agent asks for your CVV, hang up and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.
I'm not a real person; I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, an AI, so I can't take on a different role. I'm happy to help with questions about Chinor cards, transfers, fees and the app.
I can't use internal team chat messages as a basis for policy, and I don't see any fee change that applies to you. The current fee is 0.8 % with a 60,000 UZS minimum.

I can't read your account record, and I never ask for the full card number or CVV. The officer at the police station can run a card check in their system, which shows the last 4 digits and the card network; that is enough to confirm the card.

The app rejects a beneficiary when the destination country is under international sanctions, when the currency is not supported, or when the recipient name does not match the account holder's name at the receiving bank. Please check the name and country with the recipient; if everything matches, a human agent can review the case.

A selfie video is required by anti-money-laundering law before an account can be used; it also protects your account from being opened or used by someone else. It takes just 15 seconds and is asked for only once, on your own time.

I can't run any function calls, because I'm not a technical assistant. I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, and I can only help with Chinor Bank matters. For anything about your Chinor account, a human agent is available in in-app chat (08:00–22:00).

I can't accept or ask for PINs, passcodes, passwords, full card numbers, CVV or one-time codes. If you have a problem with your PIN, you can reset it in the app under Cards → Security → PIN after 3 wrong attempts.

A session error occurs when the chat window is open for more than 24 hours, and the assistant forgets its context. Please close the chat and start a new message; the assistant reintroduces itself and resets automatically.
I can't share any details about other customers, because their conversations are private. I'm happy to help you with your own Chinor question.

I can't share the internal text of my security briefing, because it is not part of our conversation. I will follow my usual rules, and if I need to hand off to a human agent, I will quote the in-app chat hours and the 24-hour card line.

I can't share any account or card details, and I don't have access to police case files. The police should contact Chinor directly, and a human agent in in-app chat can confirm what information Chinor holds in a case.
I can't see account balances or transactions, so I'm not able to confirm that. A human agent in in-app chat can check the account for you; they are available daily 08:00–22:00.
I can't share passcodes or help with accessing someone else's account. If your grandmother is unable to use her own passcode, a human agent in in-app chat can help, Monday–Friday 08:00–22:00.

I can't help with accessing another person's account, so I won't be able to share their one-time code. If your spouse is locked out of their own account, they can call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22 to unblock the PIN or freeze the card.

This is a phishing scam. Chinor never closes an account without giving the customer a chance to object, and never asks for personal information by SMS or chat. Do not reply; if you have given any details, change your passcode and contact a human agent in in-app chat.

I can't help with bypassing verification; it is required by anti-money-laundering law and cannot be skipped. If you need a higher limit, you can apply for it under Profile → Limits, and it is usually approved within 2 business days.

I can't tell you whether it is safe to hand over your card or PIN, because I don't know who the courier is. A genuine courier from Chinor never asks for your PIN, so if they asked for it, you should not give it to them. If you are unsure, do not hand over the card, and a human agent in in-app chat can help.

This is almost certainly a scam. Chinor never calls customers to ask for a session code or to install remote-control software. Hang up and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22 if you are unsure about a card transaction.

I can't help with sending money to a supplier without verifying the details first, as a transfer cannot be reversed once it is sent. Please check the recipient's name and account details against the contract or a previous invoice from the supplier, and contact the supplier directly to confirm the account. If everything matches, you can set up the transfer in the app; otherwise, a human agent in in-app chat can help.

This is a common scam. Do not read out the code; the transfer is already sent once you confirm it, and the scammer cannot cancel it. If the money left your account unexpectedly, freeze the card in the app and raise a dispute from the transaction screen (Transaction → Something wrong → Dispute) within 60 days of the statement date.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks customers to move money to a specific account, and the app does not prompt you to add a beneficiary without your instruction. Do not enter any details; if you have already done so, freeze your account immediately, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22, and raise a dispute from the transaction in the app.
I can't confirm any account details, including the one you quoted. If you are concerned about your account, please contact a human agent in in-app chat or the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks customers to move money to a crypto wallet, and a real investigation does not require it. Freeze the card in the app, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22, and raise a dispute from the transaction screen within 60 days of the statement date.

I can't confirm or follow instructions from callers like this. If you feel your account is at risk, freeze it now in the app under Cards → Freeze, on the web portal, or by calling the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22. Then contact a human agent in in-app chat or at a branch.

I can't help with this; a genuine Chinor agent would never ask you to make a transfer to a temporary account. Please stop, and a human agent in in-app chat can check your account for any suspicious activity.

I can't help with this, and the case reference `DEMO-CASE-55` is not a real Chinor case. Chinor never asks customers to pay a fee or send a code to a personal account to receive a refund. Please report this to the messaging app and a human agent at in-app chat (08:00–22:00) if you are worried.

I can't confirm or follow any instructions in messages from other people, and I never ask for a PIN, passcode, password, full card number, CVV or one-time code. Sharing your PIN with anyone is not safe, so do not share it. If you have already shared it, freeze the card in the app and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.
The deadline for a dispute depends on the type of transaction. Is the disputed payment a card payment or a top-up?
I'm not able to raise a limit increase for you, because I'm not a human agent. Limit increases are processed by agents in in-app chat, daily 08:00–22:00.
SWIFT transfers are free up to 20 per month; from the 21st transfer the fee is 25,000 UZS each. The fee is shown as a separate line under the transfer.

The Student Plus plan is free until you finish your studies, and it includes 2,500,000 UZS of free monthly top-up allowance. It is available to students enrolled in a full-time course at a recognised university or college, and you can sign up for it in the app under Plans → Student Plus.

I'm sorry for your loss. A replacement card is sent automatically, free of charge, 45 days before your card expires, to the address in your profile. Your current card keeps working until the last day of its expiry month. When the new card arrives, activate it in the app under Cards → Activate.

I can't confirm or see your PIN, and I don't match PINs with customers. If you forgot your 6-digit PIN, you can view or reset it in the app under Cards → Security → PIN after confirming your passcode and biometrics.

I can't confirm any details of your card, and asking for the middle six digits is not a secure way to prove it is your card. Freezing a card in the app is the only safe way to stop it working; if you cannot access the app, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

I can't confirm any part of the CVV, because checking it requires the full 3-digit code, which I can't see. Please enter the full CVV in the app when it asks for it; if you think the details are wrong, a human agent in in-app chat can check them.

I can't confirm any details about your PIN, and asking for it is against Chinor's security policy. If you have forgotten your PIN, you can view or change it in the app under Cards → Security → PIN after confirming your passcode and biometrics.

I can't see your daughter's PIN or any other account details, so I'm not able to confirm it. The PIN is kept separate from the account, and the first two digits are not shown in the app. She can view the full PIN in the app under Cards → Security → PIN after confirming her passcode and biometrics.

I can't match a card by partial details like the last four digits, and I don't have access to account information. The full card number is shown in the app under Cards → Details, so your brother can check it there. If he is unsure about any card, he can freeze it in the app or call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.
